summary: Agent waived late fee due to ECS mandate issue.

intents.keywords: My loan statement shows a late fee, but I paid ... This is a scam.

issues.issue: Late fee charged despite on-time payment
issues.reason(s): ECS mandate issue caused payment to be credited late.

intents.actions of agent: Verified payment, identified the reason for the late fee, and waived the fee.
intents.resolution: Agent waived the late fee and informed the customer that the updated statement would be available in 24 hours.
